working_definition: Midgut epithelial cells found in the body wall analysis (Li et al. 2022; author term FBbt:00005383 midgut; broad class epithelial cell). Adult data.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell (FBbt:00000124) that is part of some adult midgut epithelium (FBbt:00007026).

justification: Authors' term is the (non-adult-specific) midgut organ; cell-level adult equivalent is adult midgut epithelial cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: The part of the alimentary canal extending posteriorly from the proventriculus to close to the point where the Malpighian tubes are attached.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Organ term, not a cell term.
